description.en: Targets intrinsic faithfulness -- physics, commonsense and anatomy -- rather than the surface quality VBench 1.x measures, and is built to stay unsaturated where that suite tops out. Low scores here do not contradict high VBench scores; the two suites ask different questions.

released_reference.note: First version of the paper introducing VBench-2.0. It measures intrinsic faithfulness where VBench 1.x measures surface quality, so it is its own release and not a revision of the earlier suite.
